snippet.title: Everafter Falls - Official Update 2.0 Gameplay Deep Dive Trailer
snippet.description: Check out the Update 2.0 Gameplay Deep Dive Trailer for Everafter Falls, a top-down action-adventure simulation RPG developed by SquareHusky. Players can get the rundown on the upcoming Update 2.0 packed with new quests, new decorations, new cooking recipes, and more for players to enjoy. Update 2.0 for Everafter Falls is available now for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam, Epic Games Store, GoG).
